issues.description: tasks_group.exception() called on a cancelled gather can raise CancelledError/InvalidStateError
issues.detail: After utils.aio.gracefully_cancel and tasks_group.cancel(), calling tasks_group.exception() on a cancelled future raises CancelledError (or InvalidStateError if not done). This is inside a finally; an unexpected raise here masks the real failure and prevents ws.close() from running cleanly. Wrap in try/except or check .done()/.cancelled() first.

issues.description: audio_format hardcoded from sample_rate without validating against STTAudioFormat Literal
issues.detail: typing.cast(STTAudioFormat, f"pcm_{sample_rate}") silently produces invalid formats for any sample_rate not in the Literal set (e.g. 11025, 32000). The cast lies to the type checker and the server rejects the connection at runtime with a confusing error. Validate sample_rate against the allowed set up front and fail loudly in __init__.

issues.description: No tests added; author admits test_stt.py is broken since May 2025
issues.detail: "Deepgram did it too without tests" is not a maintainer-acceptable answer. A new 417-line WebSocket streaming class with reconnect logic, VAD state machine, and message-type dispatch lands with zero automated coverage. Either fix make_test_speech or add a minimal mocked-websocket unit test that exercises _process_stream_event for each message_type. Otherwise the next refactor will silently break this.

issues.description: Query string built by hand instead of using aiohttp/urlencode
issues.detail: Hand-rolling f"key={value}" and joining with & invites injection/escape bugs the first time someone passes a language_code with a special character. urllib.parse.urlencode exists, returns the same string, and won't quietly produce malformed URLs. Small fix, removes a class of bug.

issues.description: _recognize_impl raises NotImplementedError instead of degrading to a sensible path
issues.detail: Fine to refuse, but the message tells users to "use the original STT class for Scribe v1" which is a different model. If the contract requires recognize(), this class is incomplete; if it doesn't, the override is dead code. Pick one. Don't ship surface area that exists only to throw.

issues.description: Duplicate START_OF_SPEECH dispatch logic in two branches — bad taste
issues.detail: The "if not self._speaking: send START_OF_SPEECH; self._speaking=True" block is copy-pasted into both partial_transcript and committed_transcript handlers. This is the textbook special-case-instead-of-general smell. Extract a _mark_speaking() helper, or normalize the dispatch table so the state transition lives in one place. The maintainer six years from now will thank you.

review.summary: Patch is the right shape — follows the Deepgram/Cartesia STTv2 pattern, separate file, backward compatible, single concern. NEEDS-WORK on the reconnect finally block (tasks_group.exception() on a cancelled gather is a latent bug), the unchecked audio_format cast (lies to the type system, fails at runtime), and the absence of any tests for 417 lines of streaming/WebSocket/state-machine code. Style is otherwise consistent with the codebase voice and the WebSocket plumbing reads cleanly. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — fix the two correctness items, add at least a mocked unit test for _process_stream_event, then resubmit.
